goal: Define, for a FUTURE separately authorized bounded implementation, the smallest deterministic runtime that turns exactly one currently-valid Bora PURSUE (derived via derive_current_pursuit_state) into a local, unsubmitted, evidence-grounded Gold-family candidate package: resume DOCX, resume PDF, cover-letter DOCX, and cover-letter PDF (cover-letter pair omitted only on a valid per-application Bora-authored cover-letter opt-out record bound to the exact Job_ID and current pursuit context; a caller-supplied flag is never Bora authorization). The resume pair is generated by a deterministic, model-built Gold DOCX builder from the canonical Gold doctrine (BORA_GOLD_QUALITY_REFERENCE_V1, BORA_SPY_POND_GOLD_REFERENCE_V1, BLUEPRINT 134/137/140/141, .cursor/rules/resume.mdc) and approved Candidate Truth, and rendered only through the canonically released CAREER_OS_DOCUMENT_RENDERING_CAPABILITY_V1; the historical Gold resume DOCX is a visual/presentation exemplar and regression reference only and is no longer cloned. The cover-letter pair continues to be spawned by cloning the exact hash-verified canonical Gold cover-letter source of CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1; this reconciliation does not change the cover-letter path. This contract's existence, review, or merge creates ZERO runtime implementation authority. It leaves Pursuit Truth persistence, exact identity, Candidate/Match Truth, qualification, system recommendation, Application Truth, Gold doctrine, Drive/application-history persistence (the distinct successor milestone), and manual SUBMIT unchanged.
acceptance_conditions: AUTHORITY: creating or merging this contract authorizes no runtime implementation. The historical implementation_authorized:true of CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1 is NOT inherited. Implementation may begin only after Bora explicitly authorizes this exact reviewed canonical contract.

TRUTH AXES: Match Truth != Pursuit Truth != Application Truth; system recommendation != Bora authorization; PURSUE != SUBMIT. Package generation and every package artifact create ZERO submission authority and are never proof that Bora submitted or intends to submit.

PURSUIT GATE: package work is permitted only when a pure call to the existing pursuit_decision.derive_current_pursuit_state(current_canonical_jobs_row, append_only_PURSUIT_DECISION_log_rows) returns state=PURSUE with authorizes_pursuit=True. NO_DECISION, WATCH, REJECT, STALE_RECONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, a broken decision chain, or any derivation error fails closed before any package work. JOBS.Bora_Decision is display-only and is never read as authorization; a regression proves Bora_Decision='PURSUE' with a stale/WATCH/REJECT/NO_DECISION derived state produces no package. A prior PURSUE for a materially changed opportunity is never authorization. The implementation imports and reuses derive_current_pursuit_state and compute_context_fingerprint unchanged and never reimplements them.

FROZEN MODULES: mature truth/validation modules (pursuit_decision, exact-role and first-party identity, job_analysis, requirement_match, qualification_gate, claim_*, resume_*, evidence/experience repositories, page utilization, and related schemas) stay frozen and are consumed only through existing public/pure interfaces via import, never modified. The implementation adds only the smallest bounded package orchestrator/runtime in allowed_paths. If a required mature module lacks a safely consumable interface and modification appears necessary, implementation STOPS and returns that fact to Bora/G; it does not silently broaden the allowlist or add wrapper-by-modification.

SUBJECT: the Job_ID must exactly match an existing canonical JOBS row; unknown or noncanonical identifiers (discovery-platform IDs, URLs, screenshots, company/title text, synthetic IDs) fail closed with no output.

PRE-PACKAGE ORDER: before any drafting, DOCX mutation, or other candidate-facing package work, the implementation requires, in this order and each fail-closed: (1) derived Pursuit Truth = PURSUE; (2) a recorded package-time reopen of the exact current first-party posting; (3) exact canonical role/requisition identity revalidation; (4) current actionability revalidation; (5) revalidation of the actual application transition/destination; (6) the canonical Gold resume doctrine records (docs/resume/BORA_GOLD_QUALITY_REFERENCE_V1.json and docs/resume/BORA_SPY_POND_GOLD_REFERENCE_V1.json) read from the canonical repository with their SHA-256 digests recorded; (7) exact canonical Gold cover-letter source supplied (unless a valid, schema-validated, Bora-authored cover-letter opt-out record bound to this exact Job_ID and current pursuit authorization context per the COVER-LETTER OPT-OUT condition is present); (8) the cover-letter Gold source (unless validly opted out), and the historical Gold resume exemplar only when supplied for regression comparison, each with SHA-256 equal to the docs/gold/CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1.json manifest value; (9) canonical current JD requirements loaded; (10) canonical Requirement/EvidenceMatch output loaded; (11) an explicit JD-to-evidence crosswalk built per BLUEPRINT 140.4 from that existing EvidenceMatch truth with no new or parallel matching/scoring schema; (12) the exact Gold cover-letter source cloned, never reconstructed or regenerated, and the approved resume model built, validated by pre-render Gold QA, and emitted as a deterministic Gold DOCX with a structure map generated from the same model; (13) only bounded evidence-grounded candidate-facing content permitted, every factual assertion tracing to approved Candidate Truth.

PACKAGE-TIME ATTESTATION (human-operated recheck preserved): the runtime is pure and performs no network, browser, Gmail, Sheets, or Drive I/O, and this contract authorizes no browser automation and defines no browser-fetch semantics. The package-time first-party reopen remains a supervised operator-flow act per BORA_PACKAGE_SPAWN_GATE_V1. The runtime consumes an explicit, current package-time actionability/revalidation attestation, validated by the smallest schema necessary (schemas/package_actionability_attestation.schema.json), bound at minimum to: the exact canonical Job_ID; the exact current first-party role/requisition identity; the current first-party URL/destination as canonically represented; the actionability result recording all four positive semantic-quorum signals (matching role/title identity, matching requisition identity, substantive current JD content, current actionable application route) with no dead/error-state veto; and recheck time/provenance sufficient to distinguish an old check from the current package run, including a binding to the decision_context_fingerprint and latest pursuit event_id in force. Package generation fails closed, before any package work, when the attestation is missing, negative, for another Job_ID, for another or materially changed opportunity, stale relative to the package-generation context, or inconsistent with current canonical identity/pursuit context. HTTP 200, a surviving requisition token, an ATS shell, an Apply-like control, discovery indexes, aggregators, caches, prior captures, chat summaries, or memory can never satisfy or rescue it. Failure is reported using the existing role_status / source_verification_status axes with no new persisted enum.

GOLD SOURCE INTEGRITY: COVER LETTER (unchanged): the runtime consumes the cover-letter Gold DOCX only as an independently retrieved, caller-supplied input through the already-established CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1 Drive path and reads expected SHA-256 values from docs/gold/CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1.json (cover-letter DOCX 264f7a8cc194e0211ce7f0af411b0ab6c07fa2438c557aa2e470536fded67e90; visual-reference PDF 0b7da43108b0fae5ba4211078b4308cad9014d1e11cb533bc25ed64feec8df42, verified separately and used only as a QA visual reference, never as a second cover-letter source). A missing source or hash mismatch stops with COVER_LETTER_GOLD_REFERENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED; the runtime never reconstructs, converts, normalizes, resaves, or substitutes a visually equivalent cover-letter document, never mutates the source bytes in place, and never writes Gold binaries into the repository. RESUME (reconciled): the production resume is generated deterministically from the canonical Gold doctrine records and approved Candidate Truth, not cloned. The historical Gold resume DOCX (resume_gold_docx of CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1, SHA-256 ec3a9f9c6e2fc429e01892f61a074a71319ec6586566b6c1cf60808eba2f3f70) is a visual/presentation exemplar and regression reference only: it is not Candidate Truth, is not required for production generation, is never a source of facts or wording, and its legacy Word parts (customXml, theme dependence, large inherited style payloads) are not reproduced. The GOLD_REFERENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED stop of BORA_PACKAGE_SPAWN_GATE_V1 continues to bind unreconciled manual or agent spawning; for this runtime the equivalent stop is GOLD_DOCTRINE_RECORD_REQUIRED: a missing or unreadable Gold doctrine record, or a model or DOCX that fails Gold QA, stops with no output.

CLAIM AND EVIDENCE LINEAGE: every candidate-facing factual assertion in the resume model, and every assertion added or changed relative to the Gold cover-letter clone, must trace through existing claim/evidence lineage utilities (claim_lineage, resume_lineage, resume_semantic) to an approved claim and evidence record; STRONG/SUPPORTED may guide emphasis, PARTIAL only within its recorded transfer boundary, NONE remains a visible gap, UNKNOWN remains unresolved. Unsupported, fabricated, or evidence-mismatched claims fail closed. The exemplar cover letter and Gold resume are never treated as Candidate Truth; exemplar role-specific facts are never reused verbatim in another role's letter.

IMMUTABLE FIELDS: personal/factual protected fields (name, contact block, hyperlinks, employer names, dates, titles under existing protected-metadata and display-title-approval rules, education) are proven value-for-value equal to the approved canonical Candidate Truth, protected-metadata and approved contact/link records for the resume model, and byte-for-byte or value-for-value unchanged from the Gold clone for the cover letter, using the existing immutable-field validators; any mutation fails closed.

CANDIDATE-FACING SAFETY: output text is scanned deterministically for internal Career OS/governance vocabulary (at minimum the terms enumerated in BORA_PACKAGE_SPAWN_GATE_V1 internal_jargon_translation_requirement, e.g. human approval, operating system, fail-closed, queue-level eligibility, deterministic boundary, Candidate Truth) unless independently job-relevant; a hit fails closed. Cover-letter behavior follows BORA_COVER_LETTER_GOLD_REFERENCE_V1: one page, recruiter-natural, truthful, role-specific, real hyperlink objects, no invented domain claims.

GOLD-FAMILY QUALITY: existing doctrine validators are reused, not redesigned: rejection on a PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY heading, noncanonical section order, noncanonical Title | Employer grammar, missing required hyperlink objects, rendered overflow/clipping/overlap, sub-92-percent meaningful page utilization (existing evaluate_resume_page_utilization), under-filled or structurally degraded output, or other material Gold-family drift, unless a documented explicit employer format instruction exists. Rendered-artifact QA is required, not inferred from source text. For the resume these doctrine rules are enforced by the executable Gold QA of the GOLD QA (EXECUTABLE) condition; JSON-record doctrine checks alone never satisfy this condition.

OUTPUTS: the expected package is the canonical four-artifact survivor package of BORA_COVER_LETTER_GOLD_REFERENCE_V1, bound by deterministic artifact ROLE and required FORMAT, not by invented filenames: resume_docx, resume_pdf, cover_letter_docx, cover_letter_pdf. It is produced regardless of which single format is later submitted; the cover-letter pair is omitted only on a valid per-application Bora-authored cover-letter opt-out record satisfying the COVER-LETTER OPT-OUT condition, never on a caller Boolean or free-form flag, never because an employer lacks a cover-letter field, and never because rendering capability is missing. The repository establishes no canonical package-output filename convention and this contract does not invent one. Any implementation filename policy must be deterministic, collision-safe for the exact canonical Job_ID/package identity (package_generation_id), non-authoritative, covered by tests, and incapable of changing job identity or provenance (identity and provenance live in the manifest, never in a filename). If exact filename semantics become consequential and cannot be derived from canonical repository doctrine, implementation must stop for governance adjudication. Artifacts are written only to a caller-designated LOCAL output location.

MANIFEST AND PROVENANCE: each run emits a deterministic package manifest (validated by schemas/gold_package_manifest.schema.json) binding Job_ID; latest pursuit event_id and decision_context_fingerprint; Gold source filenames, drive_file_ids, and verified SHA-256 values; JD-requirements digest; EvidenceMatch digest; crosswalk digest; the package-time actionability attestation digest; the canonical digest of the cover-letter opt-out record (null when none is present); per-artifact SHA-256 values; and package_run_id. Request shape, including the cover-letter opt-out record, is validated by schemas/gold_package_request.schema.json. For the resume artifacts the manifest additionally binds the SHA-256 of each Gold doctrine record consumed, the resume model digest, the structure-map digest, the expected hyperlink-set digest, the canonical renderer identity (canonical main SHA, adapter SHA-256 and the operator-verification evidence digest) and the digests of the pre-render and post-render Gold QA results; the historical Gold resume SHA-256 appears only when supplied for regression comparison.

IDEMPOTENCY: package_generation_id is exactly 'PGP_V1::' + SHA-256(lowercase hex) over canonical sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON containing exactly Job_ID, pursuit latest_event_id, decision_context_fingerprint, resume Gold doctrine digest (SHA-256 over the canonical sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON of the consumed doctrine records' SHA-256 values), resume model digest, cover-letter Gold sha256 (null only under a valid opt-out), cover-letter opt-out record digest (null when no opt-out), JD-requirements digest, EvidenceMatch digest, actionability-attestation digest, and caller-supplied package_run_id. Wall-clock timestamps are excluded. DOCX output must be byte-deterministic for identical inputs (fixed archive timestamps and ordering). An exact replay yields the identical package_generation_id, manifest, and artifact hashes and no duplicate or divergent output; the same package_generation_id with a conflicting payload fails closed. A changed pursuit context, Gold hash, JD, or EvidenceMatch yields a new identity and never silently reuses or overwrites a prior package.

STALE-INPUT DETECTION: immediately before writing outputs the runtime re-derives pursuit state from the supplied current JOBS row and log rows and requires the same latest_event_id and fingerprint recorded at start; any drift, and any attestation/fingerprint binding mismatch, fails closed with no partial output left behind.

NO OUT-OF-SCOPE MUTATION: no JOBS or LOG mutation, no Bora_Decision change, no APPLICATIONS row, no docs/application/BORA_APPLICATION_HISTORY_V1.json change, no Drive/Sheets write, no submission, no PURSUIT_DECISION event, and no change to any other truth axis. A regression proves inputs (JOBS row, LOG rows, application history, Gold bytes) are unchanged after both success and every failure path, and that state_from_ledger_rows rehydration is unaffected.

PERSISTENCE BOUNDARY: canonical order is PURSUE -> GOLD_PACKAGE_V1 -> exact package persistence in Drive/application history -> Bora manual SUBMIT. This milestone stops at local package generation. It creates no APPLICATIONS row, no application-history mutation, no Drive package persistence, no Sheets write, and no submission authority. The CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1 manifest and retrieval mechanism may be consumed read-only. Drive/application-history persistence is a distinct successor milestone requiring its own contract and authorization.

CAPABILITY HARD STOP (reconciled): CAREER_OS_DOCUMENT_RENDERING_CAPABILITY_V1 is canonically released (canonical main 28619e5b42bc5c1b3f622546848a3d3bbec1631c, operator verification 10/10 PASS), so the former premise that no proven production DOCX/PDF capability exists is obsolete for the resume. The runtime renders the resume DOCX only by calling that released capability through its canonical public interface (render_document or the governed --render command with the exact PASS operator-verification evidence); it never invokes LibreOffice, a browser or any other converter itself, never modifies the renderer, and authorizes no new dependency, rendering engine, external service, toolchain or dependency-file change. PACKAGE_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED remains the named outcome, with no partial or degraded package and no omitted required artifact, when: the released renderer or its PASS operator-verification evidence is unavailable or does not match the canonical release; the renderer rejects the generated DOCX; the rendered result fails Gold QA; a resume with three or more hyperlinks is rendered by a canonical release that does not include ORDER_INDEPENDENT_LINKAGE_V1 (the separate CAREER_OS_DOCUMENT_RENDERING_LINK_LINKAGE_AMENDMENT_V1 amendment), in which case the runtime fails closed and never drops, reorders or relocates a required link to avoid the renderer; or the cover-letter pair cannot be produced and validated. COVER-LETTER BOUNDARY: the Gold cover-letter DOCX of CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1 contains customXml and theme parts that the released preflight rejects (PART_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED), so whether a cover-letter PDF can be produced through the released renderer is NOT established by this reconciliation; until separately governed, the cover-letter pair fails closed as PACKAGE_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED and this reconciliation grants no cover-letter generation or resume-only degradation.

REQUIRED TESTS PROVE AT MINIMUM: valid current PURSUE authorizes bounded package work; WATCH fails closed; REJECT fails closed; stale PURSUE fails closed; display-only Bora_Decision=PURSUE cannot bypass derived-state validation; unknown/noncanonical Job_ID fails closed; dead/stale/unactionable/identity-mismatched posting fails closed before spawn; Gold hash mismatch fails closed for the cover-letter source and for any supplied historical resume exemplar; unsupported claim/evidence mismatch fails closed; banned internal vocabulary fails closed and clean output passes; immutable fields unchanged; Gold-family/format/layout/page-utilization validators pass; repeated identical request is idempotent and conflicting same-id request fails closed; no Application Truth mutation; no submission; no Drive/application-history persistence; no unrelated truth-axis mutation. ADDITIONAL MINIMUM TESTS (in tests/pursue_to_gold_package_v1_test.py; these add to and never weaken the list above): (A) CROSS-CONTEXT/STALE ATTESTATION: the package-time actionability/revalidation attestation fails closed, before any package work, when any authoritative binding differs from the current pursuit context, proven separately for a mismatched canonical Job_ID, a mismatched pursuit event_id, a mismatched decision_context_fingerprint, and a mismatched current application destination/URL binding where applicable; a stale or cross-context attestation cannot be reused for another Job_ID, event, fingerprint, or destination; no arbitrary numeric freshness TTL is introduced and the existing event/context binding design is preserved. (B) NO PARTIAL OUTPUT: every stale-input or other fail-closed path, and any failure before successful package completion, leaves no partial resume output, no partial cover-letter output, no partially accepted package manifest, and no partially materialized candidate package; the observable invariant is that failure produces no usable partial package; this authorizes no transactional infrastructure beyond what this contract already permits. (C) CAPABILITY BLOCKED: when the supported environment cannot produce and/or validate a required package format, the runtime fails closed with PACKAGE_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED, emits no valid candidate package, introduces no new dependency or toolchain and never invokes LibreOffice, browser automation or an external document-generation service other than through the canonical released rendering capability's public interface, and returns for Bora/G governance adjudication. (D) NO RESUME-ONLY DEGRADATION: a rejected or invalid cover-letter opt-out (claimed or requested but missing authoritative Bora provenance, malformed, unbound, stale, mismatched, other Job_ID/context, or self-asserted; the mere absence of any requested opt-out is the normal default cover-letter path, not a rejected opt-out) never becomes a resume-only package; the attempt fails closed unless the canonical Gold cover-letter path completes successfully, and resume-only output occurs only under a valid opt-out satisfying every requirement of the COVER-LETTER OPT-OUT condition.

COVER-LETTER OPT-OUT (Bora waiver preserved, authenticated and bound): Bora may explicitly waive the cover letter for a specific application, but a caller-provided Boolean or free-form flag is NOT Bora authorization. Cover-letter omission is permitted only when the request carries an explicit per-application Bora-authored cover-letter opt-out record, represented as a schema-validated object in schemas/gold_package_request.schema.json (never a free-form Boolean/string), that: (a) is backed by AUTHORITATIVE Bora-controlled approval provenance: Bora authorship/authorization is an authoritative input-provenance property established by an existing approval record or trusted provenance surface of the governed system, never a value the caller declares. Schema validation establishes only structural representation and never establishes authority (schema-valid representation != authority provenance; caller assertion != Bora authorization); a caller-supplied field or text such as authorized_by:"Bora", bora_authored:true, free-form approval text, or any equivalent self-asserted authorship/authorization value confers no authority. This contract invents no new database, signing system, or cryptographic identity infrastructure and authorizes no modification of pursuit persistence or other mature authority modules; if, when implementation is separately authorized, no existing authoritative Bora-controlled approval/provenance surface can be consumed without modifying a mature module, implementation STOPS and returns for governance adjudication and never substitutes caller-supplied authorship; (b) applies to exactly one canonical Job_ID, is per-application, and remains auditable; (c) is bound to the current pursuit authorization context by the latest applicable pursuit event_id and the exact decision_context_fingerprint in force, strongly enough that it cannot be reused across a changed opportunity or context; and (d) has a deterministic canonical digest (sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON, SHA-256 lowercase hex) that is included in deterministic package provenance, recorded in the package manifest, and included in package_generation_id. NO OPT-OUT REQUESTED != OPT-OUT REQUESTED WITHOUT AUTHORITATIVE PROVENANCE. When no cover-letter opt-out is requested or supplied, that is the normal default path: the canonical Gold cover-letter source, its exact SHA-256 verification, and all cover-letter generation and validation remain required, and package generation proceeds only if that normal cover-letter path succeeds; the absence of an opt-out is never itself a failure. When an opt-out is claimed or requested, it fails closed, with no output, if the required authoritative Bora-controlled approval provenance is missing, or if the record is malformed, unbound, stale, mismatched, or for another Job_ID or context; such a request is never treated as authorized, never silently degrades to a resume-only package, and leaves no usable partial package. When no valid bound opt-out exists, the canonical Gold cover-letter source, its exact SHA-256 verification against docs/gold/CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1.json, and all cover-letter generation and validation requirements remain fully required. A valid opt-out waives only the cover-letter pair and weakens no other requirement. REQUIRED TESTS (in tests/pursue_to_gold_package_v1_test.py, consolidated) prove at minimum: (1) no opt-out requested or supplied proceeds down the normal default path, which requires the cover-letter Gold source and hash and succeeds only if the cover-letter path succeeds, and is not itself a failure; (2) a valid opt-out with authoritative Bora provenance and exact-context bindings permits cover-letter omission; (3) a caller Boolean or free-form opt-out or waiver is rejected; (4) an opt-out or authoritative Bora approval for another Job_ID is rejected; (5) an opt-out or approval bound to a stale or wrong pursuit event_id is rejected, and one bound to a wrong decision_context_fingerprint is rejected; (6) a malformed or unbound opt-out is rejected; (7) a schema-valid opt-out that merely self-asserts Bora authorship is rejected; (8) an opt-out that is claimed or requested but has no authoritative Bora approval provenance is rejected (fails closed, no resume-only degradation, no usable partial package), a case distinct from (1); (9) any failed authority validation cannot degrade into a resume-only package.

MODEL-BUILT GOLD RESUME (RECONCILIATION): the production resume path is: current valid PURSUE -> package-time actionability/revalidation -> canonical JD requirements -> canonical Requirement/EvidenceMatch -> approved Candidate Truth and claim/evidence lineage -> role-tailored Gold resume model (validated by schemas/gold_resume_model.schema.json) -> deterministic Gold DOCX builder (src/gold_resume_docx_builder.py) -> structure map generated from the SAME model -> the canonical released renderer -> executable rendered Gold QA (src/gold_resume_qa.py) -> local package outputs -> HUMAN_REQUIRED Bora/G review; manual SUBMIT remains Bora-controlled. This replaces exact-Gold-DOCX-clone-then-bounded-edits for the resume only. The only Gold authority is the existing canonical doctrine: docs/resume/BORA_GOLD_QUALITY_REFERENCE_V1.json, docs/resume/BORA_SPY_POND_GOLD_REFERENCE_V1.json, the applicable BLUEPRINT 134/137/140/141 doctrine and .cursor/rules/resume.mdc; no second Gold standard is created. The builder reconstructs presentation from that doctrine and never copies factual content from the exemplar. The DOCX must satisfy the released preflight: no unapproved customXml, theme dependence, giant inherited styles, macros, external data or unsupported parts; fonts are declared explicitly; bytes are deterministic for identical input (fixed archive timestamps, entry order and compression).

GOLD GRAMMAR (REQUIRED DEFAULT): US Letter, one page, one column; margins left and right 0.72 inch, top 0.46 inch, bottom 0.32 inch; Liberation Sans primary (Arial only as the doctrine's metrically compatible fallback if Liberation Sans is unavailable and the renderer's font proof still passes, otherwise fail closed); centered bold name about 18.5 pt; body and contact about 10.5 pt; section headings about 11 pt bold with a thin horizontal rule and no boxes or color; centered contact line; natural role-tailored summary directly below the contact line with NO summary heading; sections in this exact order: EDUCATION, SKILLS, WORK EXPERIENCE, RELEVANT PROJECT; two-school education grammar (bold school left, month-year range right-aligned on the same line, degree line below) only when approved truth permits; three recruiter-facing skills rows modeled on Process & quality, Technical and Operations with no internal taxonomy; each work entry one bold left line 'Title | Employer' with the date range right-aligned on the same line followed by bullets; default evidence roster mechanism Winter Walk, TELUS, D Commerce and MarketMind subject to approved Candidate Truth and JD/evidence relevance (Bulmarma is not automatic and enters only through a Requirement/EvidenceMatch crosswalk that earns it); MarketMind heading 'MarketMind - Python / Streamlit Market-Screening Prototype' with a genuine right-side GitHub hyperlink; every numeric value above is read from the doctrine records and a test proves the contract and the records agree.

STRUCTURE MAP FROM THE SAME MODEL: the structure map is generated by the same code path and from the same approved resume model as the DOCX, never inferred from the finished file, and the DOCX and map are bound by a recorded digest. Roles map only to the existing canonical renderer vocabulary: CONTACT_LINE, SECTION_HEADING, SUMMARY_TEXT, EDUCATION_LINE, EMPLOYMENT_HEADER, BULLET_TEXT, PROJECT_HEADER, SKILLS_LINE. The candidate name remains renderer-nonmeaningful under the current canonical structure-map rule. No finer semantic role is introduced without a separate contract amendment proving it is required.

HYPHEN-SAFE LAYOUT: because the released renderer fails closed on a rendered line-end hyphen that is not in the source token (RENDER_ATTRIBUTION_INCOMPLETE / HYPHENATION_OBSERVED), generation solves wrapping deterministically before rendering using Liberation Sans advance widths read with the Python standard library from font bytes whose SHA-256 equals the canonical runtime-manifest font inventory (no new data file or dependency), with a bounded paragraph-local presentation adjustment (for example a right indent) chosen with a documented safety margin. The solver may change presentation properties only. It may not change approved factual wording, substitute Unicode punctuation invisibly, weaken attribution, or weaken the 92-percent floor; when no bounded adjustment exists the package fails closed.

HYPERLINKS: the default production links, once each target is canonically approved, are the email mailto link, the LinkedIn profile, the GitHub profile and the MarketMind GitHub repository, each as a genuine OOXML hyperlink relationship with its human-readable label (LinkedIn, GitHub) and never as raw URL text or merely styled text. The rendered PDF must contain a genuine /Link URI annotation for each, with the exact expected destination. Gold QA verifies the expected destination-and-label set exactly, independently of PDF annotation order and with no extra or fabricated link. A four-link resume requires ORDER_INDEPENDENT_LINKAGE_V1 in the canonical renderer release used (the separate CAREER_OS_DOCUMENT_RENDERING_LINK_LINKAGE_AMENDMENT_V1 amendment); until then the runtime fails closed as PACKAGE_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED and never reduces, reorders or relocates links.

GOLD QA (EXECUTABLE): src/gold_resume_qa.py is executable validation, not JSON doctrine checks only. PRE-RENDER it fails closed unless: there is no summary heading; section order is exact; heading grammar is canonical; there are exactly three skills rows; every work header is 'Title | Employer' with a right-aligned date; the roster policy is satisfied; the hyperlink destination allowlist is exact; every factual assertion has approved Candidate Truth lineage; the recruiter-jargon scan (at minimum the BORA_PACKAGE_SPAWN_GATE_V1 terms) is clean; DOCX bytes are deterministic; the structure-map binding holds; font declarations and the preflight-compatible package rules hold; and metrics match the doctrine. POST-RENDER it requires: canonical renderer PASS; exactly one US-Letter page; utilization at or above 0.92 via the existing evaluator; no overlap, clipping or overflow; attribution PASS; font PASS; the expected link set exactly preserved as genuine PDF URI annotations; no fabricated PDF link; section order and heading text preserved; and human visual review still pending. A resume with zero links when links are expected is never Gold. A failed QA yields no package and a reported gap; the runtime never adds filler, invents claims or lowers the floor.

CANDIDATE TRUTH AND DISPLAY GAPS (RECORDED, NOT INVENTED): the historical exemplar never promotes a fact into Candidate Truth. Current gaps that the runtime must treat as blocked until Bora approves them in the proper records: (a) Brandeis GPA: canonical evidence records the exact value 3.635 and says not to round it, so a GPA, if included, is shown as 3.635, and 3.64 is forbidden until Bora explicitly approves a display-rounding policy; (b) TELUS: the canonical employer name is TELUS Digital Bulgaria and no alias such as TELUS Digital is used without a separately approved display alias; (c) UNWE: CLAIM_EDU_UNWE_001 is not human-approved, so automatic inclusion is blocked pending Bora approval; (d) D Commerce: the employer reference is verified but CLAIM_DCOMMERCE_001 is not human-approved and no canonical claim exists for the exemplar's second D Commerce bullet, so automatic inclusion is blocked and exemplar wording is never copied; (e) contact links: canonical contact data holds LinkedIn text but no authoritative GitHub profile record, and the GitHub profile and MarketMind repository destinations are canonical-data gaps until Bora approves them into the proper truth/contact record. A blocked entry is excluded and reported; if the resulting package fails Gold QA the runtime emits no package and reports the gap rather than adding unapproved content.
